Interpretation:
- AU10TIX and Onfido have the strongest public overall posture.
- Jumio and Socure are broadly strong, especially with active challenge flows and synthetic-media controls.
- IDology is solid but public deepfake detail is less explicit.
- Veriff has the highest public likelihood of exposure under a passive-only liveness model with degraded uploads.
